sloka: अथ घोषः सुतुमुलो हरीणां समजायत ।वृक्षानारुजतां चैव गुर्वीरागृह्णतां शिलाः ।। ६.५७.४३ ।।।।
transliteration: atha ghoṣaḥ sutumulo harīṇāṁ samajāyata ।vṛkṣānārujatāṁ caiva gurvīrāgṛhṇatāṁ śilāḥ ।। 6.57.43 ।।।।

translations.english: And when the monkeys took hold of heavy rocks and trees for fighting exceedingly tumultuous clamor arose.
